definition.en: The Universal Postal Union (UPU) is a specialized agency of the United Nations that coordinates postal policies among member nations, ensuring a universal network of up-to-date products and services.
definition.hi: The Universal Postal Union (UPU) is a specialized agency of the United Nations that coordinates postal policies among member nations, ensuring a universal network of up-to-date products and services.

importanceInUpsc.en: For UPSC GS-3, the UPU is significant as it represents international cooperation in trade facilitation and logistics. Understanding its role helps in analyzing global supply chains and India's integration into the international postal framework.
